author: Half_Steel
body: I think you should be able to post topics, and topics only, anonymously on the forums. A lot of times I need advice and I don't want my irl friends to read it, so I just bottle it up inside. But some times I just want to pour my heart out, and ask for advice. Obviously mods would be able to see who it actually is, but I think this would be useful.
